errors.text_span: The figure shows the distribution of the number of news articles and the number of new COVID-19 cases in China from January 2020 to December 2020.
errors.evidence: The chart actually shows global daily new COVID-19 cases and related news articles from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022, not data from China or the year 2020.

The machine-generated description does not mention the x-axis label (dates from July 1, 2022, to August 26, 2022), the left y-axis label (daily new cases, range 0–1,800,000), or the right y-axis label (news articles, range 0–6,000).
The description does not mention the blue-green bars representing daily new COVID-19 cases or the blue line representing the number of related news articles.

The description does not explain the purpose of the chart, which is to show the trend and relationship between daily new COVID-19 cases and related news articles globally over the specified time period.
